target.title: fix(slack): include assistant loading messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Slack assistant threads currently show one static processing status while OpenClaw prepares a reply, even though Slack supports rotating loading messages for longer-running turns.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Slack-owned status adapter now forwards four short loading messages when reply processing starts. The existing `is typing...` status remains unchanged, clear calls still send only an empty status, and the adapter caps loading messages at Slack's documented maximum of ten.

## User Impact

Users in Slack assistant threads can see rotating temporary progress notes while OpenClaw works, without any configuration change or change to the existing static status wording.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/slack/src/monitor.tool-result.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/dispatch.preview-fallback.test.ts` — 2 files, 109 tests passed locally.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwpzjhsn9vh8tqysv2p6q4yj` — `check:changed` passed extension production/test typechecks, focused lint, guards, and import-cycle checks; the same 109 focused tests passed. Actions: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28712567993
- Slack's current `assistant.threads.setStatus` contract documents `loading_messages` as an optional rotating list with a maximum of ten: https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/assistant.threads.setStatus/
- Installed `@slack/web-api@7.16.0` types expose `AssistantThreadsSetStatusArguments.loading_messages?: string[]`.
- Live Slack canary on exact head `957654bde6ba8ae367172c9f6f411afb2f9e668f` passed through the native Slack driver with Convex-leased maintainer credentials and redacted metadata; reply matched in 3975ms. Evidence: `qa-evidence.json`, `slack-qa-report.md`, and redacted transport observations under the local QA artifact directory.
- Fresh Codex autoreview of the complete rebased branch: no findings; best narrow fix, confidence 0.98.

Slack accepted the changed branch in a real workspace. No visual capture of Slack's client-side rotation is claimed; the exact `loading_messages` payload is covered by focused tests and Slack's documented API contract.
